milestone.title: v0.4.0-alpha.3
milestone.description: Conditional optional-feature qualification: native/socket I/O #1145→#1156→#1161, libuv #1146→#1155→#1158, and restricted numerical workers #1088→#1136. Refresh against current main; require combined ownership, cancellation, deadlines, cleanup, regression and platform evidence. Keep APIs experimental and defer any unqualified stack at rc.1. No committed date.
